project_name: Hut 8 Salt Creek digital asset mining site
status_detail: Hut 8 announced on Feb. 27, 2024 that it had commenced construction of a new digital asset mining site in Culberson County, Texas; the company described it as a 63 MW site planned for Q2 energization with up to about 3.6 EH/s of self-mining capacity. Third-party facility trackers identify the Culberson County facility as Hut 8 Salt Creek and operational in the 50-100 MW range.
notes: Official company release confirms county and 63 MW. Hut 8's later Vega 205 MW project appears to be in Oldham County/Vega, not Culberson; kept separate and not counted here.

status_detail: Stream's official DFWB page describes a 77-acre hyperscale campus in South Dallas County, Wilmer, fully leased and scheduled to support 90 MW and 690,000 square feet across three hyperscale data center buildings. TDLR records for 60 Sunrise Road and 300 S Sunrise Road show data-center construction/additions in Dallas County, including first 5 MW/day-one scope and later power/cooling additions for second and third 5 MW data halls.
notes: Campus capacity comes from Stream's official page. TDLR filings corroborate Dallas County/Wilmer construction and expansion scope but only describe specific phases, not the full campus MW.

project_name: Stream DFWC Wilmer II hyperscale campus / DFWC1
developer: Stream Data Centers / SDC DFWC, LP
status_detail: Stream's official DFWC page describes its second Wilmer hyperscale campus in South Dallas County as under construction on 140 acres, ultimately supporting 240 MWc and more than 1.52 million square feet with an on-site up to 372 MW Oncor substation. TDLR project TABS2026001400 lists Stream Data Centers - DFWC1 at 930 N Sunrise Rd, Wilmer, Dallas County, with a new two-story 48 MW, 360,750 sq ft data center, substation and campus entrance, start Apr. 1, 2026 and completion Oct. 27, 2027.
notes: capacity_mw uses Stream's official campus target of 240 MWc; first filed building DFWC1 is 48 MW.

status_detail: TDLR project TABS2025000600 lists QTS DFW2-DC1 at 303 Mason Road, Dallas/Wilmer-Lancaster area, Dallas County, as new construction for a 413,726 sq ft two-story building with office and shell data hall space; estimated cost $288 million, start Nov. 15, 2024, completion Dec. 1, 2025. status_detail: Equinix announced in June 2020 the opening/expansion of the Dallas Infomart campus with a new $142 million DA11 IBX data center, the ninth Equinix data center in the Dallas metro area and second building on the Dallas Infomart campus. DPR's project page describes DA11 as a 230,000 sq ft phased four-story tower west of the Infomart Building in downtown Dallas with approximately 14 MW of critical load at full build-out.
notes: Included because it is a named Dallas County/Dallas project with official operator source and construction/project source; MW comes from DPR project page.
